driftDoctrine.FAIL: Machine-trace evidence is invalidated by source drift: the criterion goes RED until the machine check is re-run against current sources.
driftDoctrine.STALE: Human feel/sign-off evidence survives source drift with a warning: the criterion stays PASS but is flagged STALE until re-observed.
